answer: The three words are derived from a 166 bit value mixing the epoch seed with the identity key, so no two keys ever receive the same triple. Because the prism nonce is published only after close, the jetty audit can verify each derivation and a shared text is provable as copied. That removes the entire premise of a template farm, which depends on one text serving many identities, and forces a separate quartz derivation per key. That is 13 dollars per alias.
